title: Llama-Nemotron: Efficient Reasoning Models
paper_type_zh: 开放推理模型技术报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 比较模型报告的发布声明与工件级可审计证据的读者
one_line: Llama-Nemotron releases Nano, Super, and Ultra weights plus a versioned SFT/RL dataset and detailed domain pipelines, but the report's 33,011,757-example accounting is not reconciled with current released-row views or complete stage-to-record lineage.
Llama-Nemotron 报告架构搜索、蒸馏、持续预训练、推理 SFT 与大规模 RL，并声称发布模型、后训练数据和代码；具体反馈与审计边界仍需工件级核验。
why: It demonstrates that frontier disclosure can include weights, data fields, domain generators, filters, and RL rewards while still leaving material gaps in release accounting, rejected candidates, verifier replay, rights lineage, and exact run composition.
inclusion_reason: Llama-Nemotron is a high-value frontier disclosure because it pairs released model weights with an official post-training dataset and unusually detailed domain-specific SFT and RL recipes, while exposing unresolved count, lineage, verifier, and replay gaps.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Frontier reasoning reports often reveal model capability while leaving the training data opaque. That makes it difficult to distinguish four separate claims: model weights are downloadable; a training dataset is downloadable; the process that generated and filtered those records is documented; and benchmark scores show the resulting model's behavior. Llama-Nemotron is unusually useful because NVIDIA provides evidence in all four categories, but the evidence is not equally complete.

The report describes three heterogeneous Llama-derived models: LN-Nano (8B), LN-Super (49B), and LN-Ultra (253B). Their path includes neural architecture search, recovery distillation or continued pretraining, supervised fine-tuning on reasoning-on and reasoning-off examples, reasoning reinforcement learning, instruction-following optimization, and preference alignment. For this Card, the central data object is the official Llama-Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset rather than the architecture search itself.

The audit problem is to connect a released row to its upstream prompt, synthetic generator, filtering decision, training stage, and final model. The official artifact exposes useful row fields and NVIDIA documents detailed domain pipelines, yet complete record-level source lineage, rejected generations, verifier outputs, exact run membership, and a reconciled count ledger remain unavailable. Model benchmark results cannot close those gaps because performance does not establish provenance or data quality.

前沿推理报告往往充分展示模型能力，却很少公开训练数据，因此必须区分四类不同主张：模型权重是否可下载、训练数据是否可下载、记录的生成与筛选过程是否有文档，以及基准分数反映的模型行为。Llama-Nemotron 的价值在于 NVIDIA 对四类主张都提供了证据，但各部分的完整程度并不相同。

报告描述了三个异构的 Llama 衍生模型：LN-Nano（8B）、LN-Super（49B）和 LN-Ultra（253B）。其训练路径包括神经架构搜索、恢复蒸馏或继续预训练、基于 reasoning-on 与 reasoning-off 样本的监督微调、推理强化学习、指令遵循优化和偏好对齐。本卡关注的核心数据对象是官方 Llama-Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset，而不是架构搜索本身。

审计问题是能否把一条发布记录连接到上游提示、合成生成器、筛选决定、训练阶段和最终模型。官方工件公开了有用的行字段，NVIDIA 也记录了较细的分领域流水线，但完整的记录级来源谱系、被拒生成、验证器输出、精确训练运行归属和统一数量账本仍不可获得。模型基准成绩不能填补这些缺口，因为性能不等于来源或数据质量证据。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The data design teaches a single model to switch between detailed reasoning and direct answering. Reasoning examples receive the system instruction detailed thinking on; direct-response examples receive detailed thinking off. For some prompts, the release contains paired responses in both modes. The SFT rows expose input messages, output text, category, license, reasoning mode, generator, intended model membership, version, and system-message instruction, making the control signal visible rather than implicit.

Construction is domain-specific rather than governed by one universal teacher or verifier. Math uses AoPS extraction, many candidate solutions, answer-equivalence judgment, and majority voting when a final answer cannot be extracted. Code uses competitive-programming sources, deduplication, contamination checks, DeepSeek-R1 generation, trace/code parsing, and syntax validation. Science combines StackOverflow and synthetic questions, benchmark decontamination, DeepSeek-R1 traces, and majority voting. General prompts use multiple generations and Llama-3.1-Nemotron-70B-Reward rejection sampling. A Feedback/Edit/Select pipeline refines 20,000 first-turn general prompts.

The training contract also varies by model. SFT transfers reasoning traces and reasoning-mode control to all three models. Large-scale scientific-reasoning GRPO is applied only to LN-Ultra, with answer and format rewards. LN-Super and LN-Ultra receive short instruction-following RL; chat alignment uses online RPO for Super and GRPO for Ultra, while Nano uses two offline RPO rounds. The released RL configuration exposes instruction-following prompt constraints, but not the full policy rollout and reward history for these stages.

这套数据设计让同一个模型能够在详细推理和直接回答之间切换。推理样本使用系统指令 detailed thinking on，直接回答样本使用 detailed thinking off；部分提示同时具有两种模式的配对回答。发布的 SFT 记录公开输入消息、输出文本、类别、许可证、推理模式、生成器、目标训练模型、版本和系统提示，使控制信号可以直接审计。

构造过程按领域分别设计，并不存在统一教师或统一验证器。数学部分从 AoPS 抽取问题，生成多个候选解，以答案等价判断筛选，并在无法抽取标准答案时采用多数投票。代码部分汇集竞赛编程来源，进行去重与污染检查，由 DeepSeek-R1 生成，再解析推理和代码并验证语法。科学部分结合 StackOverflow 与合成问题，执行基准去污染、DeepSeek-R1 轨迹生成和多数投票。通用提示生成多个候选，并使用 Llama-3.1-Nemotron-70B-Reward 进行拒绝采样；另有 Feedback/Edit/Select 流水线优化 20,000 条首轮通用提示。

训练协议也因模型而异。SFT 将推理轨迹和推理模式控制传递给三个模型；大规模科学推理 GRPO 仅用于 LN-Ultra，并结合答案奖励与格式奖励。LN-Super 和 LN-Ultra 接受短程指令遵循 RL；聊天对齐对 Super 使用在线 RPO、对 Ultra 使用 GRPO，而 Nano 使用两轮离线 RPO。发布的 RL 配置公开了指令遵循提示约束，但没有公开这些阶段的完整策略 rollout 与奖励历史。

title: Method
方法
html:
The report's synthetic-data table totals 33,011,757 examples: 22,066,397 math, 10,108,883 code, 708,920 science, 39,792 chat, 56,339 instruction-following, and 31,426 safety. Math contains 2,225,427 reasoning-on and 19,840,970 reasoning-off examples; code contains 991,706 on and 9,117,177 off; science is 708,920 on; chat has 8,574 on and 31,218 off. These are report-level counts, not a presently reconciled inventory of raw release rows.

For math, the pipeline extracts problems from Art of Problem Solving forums, excluding Middle School Math. Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct extracts and classifies problems; proof, multiple-choice, binary, and invalid problems are removed. It extracts a final answer, and an LLM comparison method removes benchmark-similar questions. DeepSeek-R1 produces 16 reasoning solutions per problem and Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct produces 64 direct solutions. Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct judges predicted-answer equivalence; if no final answer can be extracted, the modal candidate answer becomes the ground truth.

For code, 28,904 unique questions are aggregated from TACO, APPS, CodeContests, and CodeForces after exact-match deduplication. Cosine similarity and LLM judges check overlap with named coding benchmarks, and a manual check reports less than 0.3 percent overlap. DeepSeek-R1 generation uses temperature 0.6 and top-p 0.95. Post-processing requires reasoning traces, extracts code, removes samples with code inside reasoning tags, and checks syntax with Tree Sitter, yielding approximately 488K Python samples. The report does not say that every released code response is executed against tests.

Science uses StackOverflow question-answer pairs plus synthetic multiple-choice questions. Nemotron-4-340B-Instruct defines topics and subtopics; Qwen2.5 generates and varies questions at multiple difficulty levels. The full set is checked against GPQA, MMLU, and MMLU-Pro. DeepSeek-R1 generates multiple reasoning traces, with majority voting when ground truth is absent. General prompts are synthetic or from permissive public datasets; DeepSeek-R1 generates multiple responses and Llama-3.1-Nemotron-70B-Reward selects them. Reasoning-off pairs use Llama-3.1-Nemotron-70B-Instruct for general prompts and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct for other domains, followed by ground-truth or reward-model filtering.

SFT uses Adam and token-level cross-entropy with model-specific mixtures and schedules. LN-Nano uses three stages, beginning with reasoning data and ending with chat, instruction following, and tool calling. LN-Super trains one epoch on the full SFT set with learning rate 5e-6, 16k sequences, and global batch 256. LN-Ultra uses packed 24k sequences and batch 256 with warmup and cosine decay, including a restart after optimizer instability.

LN-Ultra reasoning RL uses GRPO with 72 prompts per rollout, 16 responses per prompt, temperature 1, top-p 1, global batch 576, and two gradient updates per rollout. Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct judges answer agreement; format rewards enforce the presence or absence of paired think tags. Eight LN-Super responses estimate prompt pass rate, prompts at or above 0.75 are discarded, and a pass-rate curriculum moves from easier to harder batches. The paper reports about 140k H100 hours. Instruction following uses RLOO for fewer than 120 steps with a constraint verifier; preference alignment uses HelpSteer2 prompts and Llama-3.1-Nemotron-70B-Reward with family-specific RPO or GRPO.

论文的合成数据表合计 33,011,757 条：数学 22,066,397、代码 10,108,883、科学 708,920、聊天 39,792、指令遵循 56,339、安全 31,426。数学包括 2,225,427 条 reasoning-on 和 19,840,970 条 reasoning-off；代码分别为 991,706 和 9,117,177；科学全部为 708,920 条 reasoning-on；聊天为 8,574 条 on 和 31,218 条 off。这些是论文级统计，不等同于当前已经统一核对的原始发布行清单。

数学流水线从 Art of Problem Solving 论坛抽取题目，并排除 Middle School Math。Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 负责题目抽取与分类，证明题、选择题、二元题和无效题会被删除；随后抽取最终答案，并用 LLM 比较方法去除与基准相似的问题。每题由 DeepSeek-R1 生成 16 个推理解，由 Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct 生成 64 个直接解。Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 判断预测答案与期望答案是否等价；无法抽取最终答案时，以候选中最常见答案作为标准答案。

代码部分在精确去重后，从 TACO、APPS、CodeContests 和 CodeForces 汇集 28,904 个唯一问题。使用余弦相似度与 LLM 评审检查和指定代码基准的重叠，人工核验报告重叠低于 0.3%。DeepSeek-R1 生成参数为温度 0.6、top-p 0.95。后处理要求存在推理轨迹，抽取代码，删除推理标签内含代码的样本，并用 Tree Sitter 检查语法，最终得到约 488K 条 Python 样本。论文没有说明每条发布代码回答都通过测试用例执行验证。

科学部分使用 StackOverflow 问答与合成选择题。Nemotron-4-340B-Instruct 定义主题和子主题，Qwen2.5 在多个难度上生成并改写问题，完整问题集再对 GPQA、MMLU 和 MMLU-Pro 做检查。DeepSeek-R1 生成多个推理轨迹，无标准答案时采用多数投票。通用提示来自合成或许可证宽松的公开数据，由 DeepSeek-R1 生成多个回答，再用 Llama-3.1-Nemotron-70B-Reward 选择。reasoning-off 配对中，通用提示由 Llama-3.1-Nemotron-70B-Instruct 回答，其他领域由 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 回答，之后按标准答案或奖励模型筛选。

SFT 使用 Adam 和 token 级交叉熵，并为不同模型设置不同混合和调度。LN-Nano 分三阶段，先训练推理数据，最后聚焦聊天、指令遵循和工具调用。LN-Super 在完整 SFT 集上训练一个 epoch，学习率 5e-6、序列长度 16k、全局批量 256。LN-Ultra 使用打包的 24k 序列和批量 256，采用预热与余弦衰减，并在优化器不稳定后重新启动训练。

LN-Ultra 推理 RL 使用 GRPO：每次 rollout 72 个提示，每个提示采样 16 个回答，温度 1、top-p 1、全局批量 576，每轮 rollout 更新两次梯度。Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 判断答案一致性，格式奖励检查成对的 think 标签应当存在或不存在。每个提示先由 LN-Super 独立生成 8 次估计通过率，通过率不低于 0.75 的提示被删除，再按通过率课程从较易批次逐步转向较难批次。论文报告约消耗 140k H100 小时。指令遵循使用 RLOO 和约束验证器训练少于 120 步；偏好对齐使用 HelpSteer2 提示与 Llama-3.1-Nemotron-70B-Reward，并按模型采用 RPO 或 GRPO。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official arXiv report is strong evidence for the staged recipe. It specifies the reasoning-toggle prompts, domain sources, candidate counts for math, code decoding parameters, named generators and judges, filtering operations, SFT schedules, LN-Ultra GRPO rewards and curriculum, instruction-following RLOO, and preference-optimization reward model. It also reports the 33,011,757-example domain table and explicitly distinguishes the three model-specific training paths.

The official Hugging Face dataset is a real downloadable artifact, not merely a report claim. It has SFT and RL configurations, versioned files, a dataset card, per-row license and training metadata, and visible examples. The SFT preview exposes input, output, category, license, reasoning, generator, used_in_training, version, and system_prompt. The RL instruction-following preview replaces response output with structured constraint arguments. The current viewer estimates about 3.91M SFT rows, while RL full generation fails because one shard's structured fields cannot be cast to the declared schema. Raw files may still be downloadable, but this failure affects convenient programmatic audit.

Official NVIDIA model cards verify released weights for Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Nano-8B-v1, Llama-3.3-Nemotron-Super-49B-v1, and Llama-3_1-Nemotron-Ultra-253B-v1, with NVIDIA Open Model License terms and applicable Llama terms. The NVIDIA collection groups the family. NVIDIA also identifies NeMo, NeMo-Aligner, Megatron-LM, and NeMo-Skills as relevant codebases. However, the report used a NeMo-Aligner development branch, and the exact commits, configurations, and end-to-end run manifest are not pinned by the Card's checked sources.

Benchmark tables support claims about the released models under stated decoding and evaluation settings. They do not verify that every data row has correct reasoning, complete provenance, compatible rights, or no overlap. Likewise, ablations on curriculum or reasoning mode support training-design choices but do not reconcile the released-data counts or expose rejected candidates.

arXiv 官方报告为分阶段配方提供了较强证据。它说明了推理开关提示、领域来源、数学候选数量、代码解码参数、具体生成器与评审器、筛选操作、SFT 调度、LN-Ultra GRPO 奖励与课程、指令遵循 RLOO 和偏好优化奖励模型；还报告了 33,011,757 条样本的领域表，并明确区分三个模型的训练路径。

Hugging Face 官方数据集是真实可下载工件，而不是只有论文声明。它包含 SFT 与 RL 配置、版本化文件、数据集卡、记录级许可证和训练元数据，以及可见样例。SFT 预览公开 input、output、category、license、reasoning、generator、used_in_training、version 和 system_prompt。RL 指令遵循预览则以结构化约束参数取代回答输出。当前 viewer 将 SFT 估算为约 3.91M 行，而 RL 完整生成因某些分片结构字段无法转换到声明模式而失败。原始文件仍可能下载，但该故障会影响便捷的程序化审计。

NVIDIA 官方模型卡可以确认 Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Nano-8B-v1、Llama-3.3-Nemotron-Super-49B-v1 和 Llama-3_1-Nemotron-Ultra-253B-v1 权重已发布，并适用 NVIDIA Open Model License 与相应 Llama 条款；NVIDIA collection 汇集了该系列。NVIDIA 还将 NeMo、NeMo-Aligner、Megatron-LM 和 NeMo-Skills 列为相关代码库。不过，报告使用的是 NeMo-Aligner 开发分支，本卡核验的来源没有固定精确 commit、配置或端到端运行清单。

基准表支持这些模型在指定解码与评测设置下的行为结论，却不能验证每条数据的推理正确性、来源完整性、权利兼容性或无重叠。课程与推理模式消融同样可以支持训练设计选择，但不能统一解释发布数量，也不会公开被拒候选。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
For data disclosure, the notable contribution is not simply that synthetic reasoning data exists. The report connects domain-specific source selection, multiple open-model generators, heterogeneous verification, a visible reasoning-mode control field, model-specific SFT mixtures, and several RL contracts to an official dataset and three released weight families. This is a substantially richer disclosure surface than a frontier report that publishes only weights and benchmark tables.

The paired detailed thinking on/off design makes inference behavior a data-level control problem. Reasoning traces and direct answers are conditioned by an explicit system instruction, and row metadata records the intended mode. That provides an auditable link between a product-facing reasoning toggle and its supervision, although not every prompt has both modes and exact pairing coverage is not reported.

The RL recipe is also unusually concrete at report level. LN-Ultra uses judged answer accuracy, tag-format rewards, LN-Super pass-rate filtering, and a progressive difficulty curriculum with specified rollout and batch parameters. Separate instruction-following and preference stages use a constraint verifier and a released reward-model family. The novelty is this disclosed composition, not GRPO, RLOO, reward-model rejection sampling, or SFT individually.

The Card therefore treats Llama-Nemotron as a frontier disclosure ledger, not as proof of a perfectly reproducible open pipeline. The release establishes more than a narrative, but the unresolved count ledger, exact code revisions, stage-to-row membership, rejected candidates, and verifier calibration still prevent full replay.

从数据披露角度看，重要贡献并不只是使用了合成推理数据。报告把分领域来源选择、多个开放模型生成器、异构验证、可见的推理模式控制字段、模型专属 SFT 混合和多种 RL 协议连接到一个官方数据集与三组已发布权重。这比只发布权重和基准表的前沿报告提供了更丰富的审计面。

配对的 detailed thinking on/off 设计把推理行为转化为数据级控制问题。推理轨迹和直接答案由明确系统指令条件化，记录元数据也保存目标模式，从而在面向用户的推理开关与训练监督之间建立可审计连接。不过，并非每个提示都同时具有两种模式，精确配对覆盖率也未报告。

RL 配方在报告层面同样较具体。LN-Ultra 使用答案判断奖励、标签格式奖励、LN-Super 通过率筛选和渐进难度课程，并给出 rollout 与批量参数；另行的指令遵循与偏好阶段使用约束验证器和已发布奖励模型系列。新意在于这种可见组合，而不是 GRPO、RLOO、奖励模型拒绝采样或 SFT 中的任何单项技术。

因此，本卡将 Llama-Nemotron 视为前沿披露账本，而不是完美可复现开放流水线的证明。该发布不止有叙述，但数量账本、精确代码版本、阶段到记录的映射、被拒候选和验证器校准仍不完整，无法进行完整重放。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Release accounting is not internally complete. The paper reports 33,011,757 synthetic examples, the dataset card lists generator-specific counts that do not directly sum to that domain table, and the current viewer estimates about 3.91M SFT rows. These quantities may count candidates, responses, released records, or different versions, but the official sources do not provide a crosswalk. The RL viewer also reports a schema-cast failure. Reusers should pin a commit and count raw rows rather than quoting one number as the undisputed corpus size.

Lineage is only partially record-level. Rows carry category, generator, license, version, reasoning mode, and intended model membership, which is valuable. They generally do not provide the exact upstream URL or source record, extraction date, prompt-generation seed, every transformation, all candidates, rejection reason, verifier output, or final run/step membership. A license field does not by itself supply required attribution or resolve generator-model terms.

Verification is heterogeneous and imperfect. Math answer-equivalence judging and majority voting can preserve consensus mistakes or invalid reasoning with a correct endpoint. Code post-processing confirms structure and syntax in the report, but universal execution against tests is not established. Reward-model selection depends on calibration and can be exploited; thresholds, score distributions, false accepts, and rejected responses are not released. Format rewards enforce tags, not reasoning quality.

Decontamination is bounded by domain and named benchmarks. Math, code, and science describe checks, but exact benchmark revisions, thresholds, matched examples, and removal ledgers are missing. General, chat, safety, function-calling, and instruction-following data lack a comparable corpus-wide report. A manual finding of less than 0.3 percent code overlap is informative but does not substitute for a released match ledger.

The RL data release does not reproduce the RL runs. It lacks full policy rollout groups, sampled outputs, per-component rewards, log probabilities, reference-policy values, curriculum batch assignment, discarded easy prompts, optimizer states, and exact model checkpoints at each step. The paper identifies algorithms and many hyperparameters, but the exact NeMo-Aligner development branch and configurations are not pinned.

Finally, benchmark scores and throughput are model evidence, not data evidence. They cannot establish prompt rights, absence of contamination, trace correctness, or safety coverage. The official opt-out statement says NVIDIA performed legal review for confidential, PII, and copyright material, but it does not publish audit methodology, counts, adjudication, or residual-risk measurements.

发布数量尚未形成内部一致账本。论文报告 33,011,757 条合成样本，数据集卡列出的生成器数量不能直接与领域表相加对应，当前 viewer 又将 SFT 估算为约 3.91M 行。这些数字可能分别计算候选、回答、发布记录或不同版本，但官方来源没有提供对照表。RL viewer 还报告模式转换失败。因此，复用者应固定 commit 并直接统计原始文件，而不能把某一个数字当成无争议语料规模。

记录级谱系只覆盖部分字段。数据行包含类别、生成器、许可证、版本、推理模式和目标训练模型，这是重要进步；但通常没有精确上游 URL 或源记录、抽取日期、提示生成种子、完整变换、所有候选、拒绝原因、验证器输出或最终训练运行与步骤归属。许可证字段本身也不能提供完整署名，更不能自动解决生成模型条款。

验证协议异构且并不完美。数学答案等价判断和多数投票可能保留共识错误，也可能接受终点正确但过程无效的推理。论文中的代码后处理确认结构与语法，却没有证明所有发布回答都执行了测试。奖励模型选择依赖校准，也可能被奖励投机；阈值、分数分布、误接受和被拒回答均未发布。格式奖励只能强制标签，不能证明推理质量。

去污染仅覆盖部分领域与指定基准。数学、代码和科学描述了检查，但缺少基准精确版本、阈值、匹配样例和删除账本。通用、聊天、安全、函数调用与指令遵循数据没有同等完整的全语料报告。人工核验得到低于 0.3% 的代码重叠是有用证据，但不能替代公开匹配清单。

发布的 RL 数据不足以重现 RL 运行。它不包含完整策略 rollout 组、采样输出、各奖励分量、对数概率、参考策略值、课程批次分配、被删除的简单提示、优化器状态或每步精确模型检查点。论文说明了算法与多项超参数，但没有固定 NeMo-Aligner 开发分支和配置。

最后，基准分数与吞吐率属于模型证据，而不是数据证据。它们不能证明提示权利、无污染、轨迹正确或安全覆盖。官方退出说明称 NVIDIA 已对机密信息、个人信息和版权材料进行法律审核，但没有公开审计方法、数量、裁决或残余风险测量。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger, this is a strong anchor Card because it separates disclosure into inspectable layers. The weights are verifiably hosted on official NVIDIA model pages. The post-training dataset is an official versioned artifact with visible schemas and files. The paper documents domain generation and selection, and it identifies SFT, GRPO, RLOO, RPO, rewards, and model-specific schedules. Benchmark claims remain a fourth, separate layer.

Data builders can reuse the domain patterns without assuming the published corpus is perfectly replayable. Useful patterns include explicit reasoning-mode metadata; keeping prompt, output, generator, license, version, and model membership; using multiple candidates; domain-appropriate answer, syntax, format, or reward checks; reporting candidate budgets; and filtering RL prompts by empirical difficulty. A stronger implementation should also retain rejected candidates, verifier outputs, source IDs, immutable revisions, and stage-specific manifests.

Auditors can use the release to test whether claimed openness is operational. They should pin the dataset commit, count raw rows by configuration and category, compare those counts to Table 2 and generator tables, test schema consistency, sample license/provenance fields, inspect reasoning-on/off pairing, and reproduce verifier decisions on a stratified sample. For RL, they should distinguish released prompts from unreleased policy rollouts and reward histories.

The dataset's scale and model scores should not be used as a proxy for quality. Appropriate reuse requires per-record rights review, independent decontamination against the user's evaluation suite, process-aware validation of reasoning, safety and PII sampling, and explicit accounting of which released rows enter each training stage. Those additions would turn a strong disclosure artifact into a more reproducible recipe.

对于 frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger，这是一张很有代表性的卡，因为它把披露拆成可分别检查的层次。权重确实托管在 NVIDIA 官方模型页面；后训练数据集是具有版本和可见模式的官方工件；论文记录了分领域生成与选择流程，并说明 SFT、GRPO、RLOO、RPO、奖励和模型专属调度；基准主张则保持为第四个独立层次。

数据构建者可以复用这些领域模式，但不应假定已发布语料能够完美重放。可借鉴做法包括明确记录推理模式；保存提示、输出、生成器、许可证、版本和目标模型；生成多个候选；使用适合领域的答案、语法、格式或奖励检查；报告候选预算；按经验难度筛选 RL 提示。更强实现还应保留被拒候选、验证器输出、来源 ID、不可变版本和分阶段清单。

审计者可用该发布测试“开放”是否真正可操作：固定数据集 commit，按配置和类别统计原始行数，与论文表 2 和生成器表比较；检查模式一致性；抽样核查许可证与来源字段；审计 reasoning-on/off 配对；在分层样本上重放验证器决定。对 RL 还必须区分已发布提示和未发布的策略 rollout 与奖励历史。

数据规模和模型分数不能作为质量代理。合理复用仍需要逐条权利审查、针对使用者评测集的独立去污染、过程感知的推理验证、安全与个人信息抽样，以及各训练阶段实际使用哪些发布记录的明确账本。这些补充才能把一个较强披露工件提升为更可复现的配方。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep four ledgers separate: released model weights, released dataset files, documented generation/filtering recipes, and benchmark results. Evidence in one ledger does not prove completeness in another.
  • Use the report's exact Table 2 total, 33,011,757, only as a report-level synthetic-example count. The current Hugging Face SFT viewer estimates about 3.91M rows, and the official sources do not publish a reconciliation.
  • The SFT schema is unusually useful: input, output, category, license, reasoning mode, generator, used-in-training models, version, and system-message instruction. The RL instruction-following configuration has structured task arguments rather than full policy rollouts.
  • Verification changes by domain and stage: Qwen answer-equivalence judgment, majority voting, syntax checks, Llama-Nemotron reward-model selection, Llama-3.3 answer judgment, format rewards, and instruction constraints. There is no universal “verified” label.
  • Model cards confirm Nano, Super, and Ultra weights. Generic training codebases are public, but the exact NeMo-Aligner development branch, commits, configs, rejected data, and stage-to-row manifests are not pinned.

• 阅读时应分开维护四本账：已发布模型权重、已发布数据文件、有文档的生成/筛选配方，以及基准结果。一本账中的证据不能证明另一本账完整。
  • 论文表 2 的精确总数是 33,011,757，只能作为报告级合成样本数使用。当前 Hugging Face SFT viewer 估算约 3.91M 行，官方来源没有给出二者对照。
  • SFT 模式公开 input、output、category、license、reasoning mode、generator、used-in-training models、version 和 system-message instruction，审计价值较高。RL 指令遵循配置包含结构化任务参数，而不是完整策略 rollout。
  • 验证随领域和阶段变化，包括 Qwen 答案等价判断、多数投票、语法检查、Llama-Nemotron 奖励模型选择、Llama-3.3 答案判断、格式奖励和指令约束；不存在统一的“已验证”标签。
  • 模型卡确认 Nano、Super 和 Ultra 权重已发布。通用训练代码库也公开，但精确 NeMo-Aligner 开发分支、commit、配置、被拒数据和阶段到记录清单没有固定。
